g.text: JET PROPULSION LABORATORY • CALIFORNIA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY • NASA
UNMANNED LUNAR SOFT LANDER • FIRST EXTRATERRESTRIAL ARTIFACT RETRIEVAL IN HUMAN HISTORY
Focal length 25-100mm zoom lens & 4-position color wheel.
> SEVERED & RETRIEVED BY PETE CONRAD & ALAN BEAN (EVA II)
Streptococcus mitis bacteria culture isolated post-return.
Transmitted high-rate television frames to Goldstone DSS.
Maintained earth-pointing lock via solar sensors & gyro.
792 solar cells delivering 89 Watts peak electrical power.
Dual-axis motor gimbal tracked lunar solar elevation.
Articulated pantograph arm with 1.5m extension reach.
Dug 4 bearing-strength trenches in lunar regolith.
Sample scoop inspected & photographed by Conrad on EVA II.
Spherical solid propellant motor. 9,000 lbf thrust.
Decelerated spacecraft from 2,600 m/s to 110 m/s before jettison.
